shots.camText: Medium profile two-shot on the pavement, waist up · eye level · 40 mm · locked-off
shots.line: OREN: "This belongs to the person I support."

lines.text: OREN: This belongs to the person I support.

shots.note: On the pavement: the laundrette behind her on the right, the kerb and road behind him; the street's life far off. Passers-by walk along the pavement behind her and on the far pavement.

shots.camText: Insert at ground level on her RIGHT boot · 28 mm · locked-off
shots.note: The sweeper bumps the toe of her RIGHT boot: the loose sole's gap clearly visible.
A weary glance down at the machine. A passer-by crosses soft behind her.

shots.camText: Ground level along the pavement · 24 mm · locked-off
shots.note: It reverses and tries the same gap; his LEFT slipper steps into its way and holds until it goes round them. A passer-by's feet stride past in the background.
Her brows lift slightly at his slipper. A passer-by crosses soft behind her.

shots.camText: Her point of view: Oren centred and symmetrical, chest up · 32 mm · locked-off
shots.line: OREN: "There is a community meal service at the clinic on Mercer Street. Lunch ends at two. It is one thirty-one."

lines.text: OREN: There is a community meal service at the clinic on Mercer Street. Lunch ends at two. It is one thirty-one.

shots.note: Exact, unhurried, the time said precisely. People pass soft behind him on the far pavement.
